title: The Specialists 3.0
what: Measures and bands only: no geometry, entity, texture or map file of the game is in this file.

units.length: units (Hammer units); m = units x 0.0254; ph = units / 72 (a standing player's height)
units.narrow: floor under 144 units wide (two player heights) is narrow

banding: Each band is n, median, q1, q3, p5, p95 across maps, a map one vote: `of maps` bands each map's own median (or value); `pooled` bands every measured place of every map, each map's places weighing 1 in all.
